headline: true
question_wording: Dacă duminica viitoare ar avea loc alegeri PARLAMENTARE și ar candida următoarele partide sau alianțe, Dvs. cu reprezentanții cărui partid ați vota?
notes: Media-only: the values are on the Verifield slide verifield-doc-004, embedded in the Libertatea article verifield-doc-003, which says the poll was 'realizat pentru USR de Verifield, potrivit surselor Libertatea' (no Verifield report was found). The client is not recorded: 'potrivit surselor' is an unattributed claim, which POLL_INGESTION §0.1 treats as a rumour (owner decision 2026-11-28), so sponsor_type = not_disclosed and the claim stays here. Base printed on the slide: '% total voturi exprimate'. No fieldwork dates, sample size, mode, population, geographic coverage, margin of error or weighting are published, so those cells are empty and poll_id and the window check use published_date (2024-08-28 18:59, datePublished of the article; the page shows 'Actualizat pe 29 aug 2024'). The article also gives a presidential question, which is not recorded (election not in the registry). Digi24 (2024-09-12) reports another Verifield survey for USR with fieldwork 15-30 August 2024 and a presidential question only; it is not this poll (see the inventory).

headline: true
question_wording: Dacă duminica viitoare ar avea loc alegeri PARLAMENTARE și ar candida următoarele partide sau alianțe, Dvs. cu reprezentanții cărui partid ați vota?
notes: Media-only: values from the slide 'Vot Parlamentare' verifield-doc-006 (USR logo, credited 'Sursă: Verifield') in the Digi24 article verifield-doc-005, base '% total voturi exprimate'. Fieldwork (7-9 October 2024), n = 1,009 (Digi24 prints '1.009'), CATI, margin of error (+/-3.09% at 95% confidence) and the client ('la comanda USR') are stated in verifield-doc-005 and in the HotNews article verifield-doc-007, which agree. published_date is the HotNews article of 2024-10-14 23:51 (+03:00), the earliest publication found (Digi24: 2024-10-15); HotNews credits News.ro, whose report was not archived. The article says the sample is 'reprezentativ pe variabilele socio-demografice'; no population or weighting is described. The printed values sum to 101.1 and the slide has two rows labelled 'Altul'; both are recorded as printed. The survey also asked a presidential question, not recorded (election not in the registry).

headline: true
question_wording: Dacă duminica viitoare ar avea loc alegeri Prezidențiale, dvs personal cu cine ați vota dintre următorii?
notes: Media-only. The total-sample base is the Verifield slide verifield-doc-013 ('Intenție de vot prezidențiale / total populatie') embedded in the Libertatea article verifield-doc-008; the expressed-option base is published only in the text of the Stiripesurse article verifield-doc-009 (heading 'cei cu opțiuni exprimate'), which also gives the fieldwork (14-18 February 2025), n = 1000, CATI and the earliest publication found (2025-03-05 22:43 +02:00; Libertatea: 2025-03-06). The client is stated by Libertatea only: 'comandat de echipa lui Crin Antonescu' (the slide names none). Libertatea says the authors did not state a margin of error and gives a turnout estimate of 58%, which is not recorded; it also says the poll assumes that Călin Georgescu runs. The Stiripesurse list of the total base omits Lavinia Șandru (1.0% on the slide); the slide is used. The EN Wikipedia index lists this poll as 14-28 Feb 2025; the articles say 14-18 February. Sample size of the expressed base, population, geographic coverage and weighting are not stated.

headline: true
question_wording: Dacă duminica viitoare ar avea loc alegeri Prezidențiale, dvs personal cu cine ați vota dintre următorii?
notes: Media-only: values from the Verifield slide 'Vot Prezidentiale' verifield-doc-011 embedded in the Libertatea article verifield-doc-010 (2025-03-31 12:30 +03:00), whose text gives the fieldwork (24-28 March 2025), n = 1,100, CATI, the margin of error (2.95% at 95% confidence) and the client ('la comanda lui Nicușor Dan'); Radio România verifield-doc-012 (2025-03-31) agrees and adds that Nicușor Dan posted it on his Facebook account (that post was not archived). The slide's base is 'voturi exprimate a celor care se duc la vot – 59% din esantion', recorded as other_subset as for the round-2 poll; the number of respondents in that base is not published. The survey also asked a parliamentary question, not recorded (election not in the registry). Population and weighting are not stated.

headline: true
question_wording: Dvs, cu cine veți vota în turul 2 al alegerilor prezidențiale ?
notes: Three bases: total sample (p. 3), expressed votes (p. 4), and expressed votes of respondents who say they will vote (p. 5, other_subset). Crosstabs by round-1 vote (pp. 6-8) are not recorded. The report names no population beyond 'reprezentativ pe variabilele socio-demografice'. The report names no client either: the sponsor comes from HotNews (verifield-doc-002, https://hotnews.ro/live-video-sondajul-prezentat-de-nicusor-dan-la-trei-zile-dupa-primul-tur-al-alegerilor-prezidentiale-1967952), whose headline says the poll was 'realizat de Verifield la comanda lui' (Nicușor Dan), who presented it on 2025-05-07 (owner decision 2026-11-27: a client stated by a media outlet is recorded as the sponsor, with its source in notes). HotNews gives the margin of error as +/-3%; the report's 3.19 is used (pollster's report wins).
